name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent tinkering with go-karts in his father's workshop. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Porto, focusing on aerodynamics and vehicle dynamics. After graduating, he joined a small Portuguese racing team, where he honed his skills in vehicle setup and data analysis. His dedication and innovative solutions quickly caught the eye of larger teams.

Before joining Trackhouse Racing, Ricardo spent several years as a senior engineer with a European touring car team, contributing to multiple championship wins. He is known for his meticulous approach, data-driven decision-making, and relentless pursuit of performance gains. At Trackhouse, Ricardo is responsible for overseeing all technical aspects of the race cars, from design and development to trackside setup and maintenance. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where engineers can freely share ideas and challenge conventional thinking. 

Ricardo distinguishes himself through his unwavering commitment to continuous improvement. He's a firm believer that even the smallest adjustments can make a significant difference on the track, and he constantly seeks out new technologies and techniques to push the boundaries of performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium height, Ricardo's intense gaze reflects his focused and demanding nature.
